title: Tenma Saki — See You At The Thank You Show!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: See You At The Thank You Show!（2★）

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's eat♪

rows.Speaker: Honami, Shiho & Ichika
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can talk while we eat, but can you all tell me how many people you've invited so far?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I can!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa was the first person I invited!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, we'd like you and the others to come see Leo/need's Thank You Show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, this is wonderful news!
I get to see another one of your shows...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'll be there no matter what, Saki!
I don't care if it's literally raining cats and dogs!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! We'd have to stop our show if anything like that were to happen.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess we can always count on Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, also! He said that he'll hand Toya and the others their tickets the next time he sees them at school♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, I was kinda hoping to do that myself...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There isn't much we can do about that since we all lead busy lives. We can't ask everyone to make time for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I even asked Kohane to give Shiraishi her ticket.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, what about Momoi?
You said you wanted to personally invite her, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup♪ I've already invited her too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you want me to go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! I want to show Happy Everyday and you, the person behind her, my full appreciation!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you've sorta already done that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, that's just the tip of the iceberg!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You made me smile so much and were an absolutely gigantic source of encouragement!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Then, I happily accept your invitation!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You weren't able to contain your excitement for the rest of the day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like when the two of us went to invite Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Harukaaa!
We've got a present for you♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, is this a ticket to a show...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, you need to explain what it's actually for first...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you mind telling me more...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You two invited her yesterday, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Shizuku talked about our show during their morning practice, which tells me that Momoi and Kiritani already knew...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Were they just being nice and playing along?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, nothing...
Anyway, who else was there?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I invited Asahina, but she said she probably won't be able to make it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Between school and other things, she always seems incredibly busy. When I messaged her about this, she said she couldn't quite work it into her schedule.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
That's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was really hoping that she'd be able to come since she's part of how I got to meet Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't worry! This won't be our last chance to show our appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because we can just make more chances by doing lots and lots of shows♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll go next.
I invited Emu and Ena the other day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, that's it for tickets and invitations!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wow...
Almost everyone we invited is gonna be there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm sure they'll be expecting to see a good performance. So, let's do our best not to disappoint them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We'll be fine!
I mean, we've been practicing like nonstop every single day!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: True. And we need to keep that momentum going after school today in order to make sure they understand just how much we appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Shiho & Honami
rows.Line:
For sure!
Yeah.
